main.description: List posts stored in a registered Gyoka feed. Supports pagination and filtering by post URI and author DID.

feed.description: Feed generator AT-URI. Required when cursor is omitted; must match the cursor when provided.

uri.description: Optional post AT-URI filter. Must match the cursor when provided.

author.description: Optional author DID filter. Must match the DID in uri when both are provided, and must match the cursor when provided.

limit.description: Maximum number of posts to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor that includes the paging position and normalized search conditions.
Opaque cursor for retrieving the next page with the same search conditions.

errors.name: AuthenticationRequired
errors.description: Returned when service authentication is required and the caller is not authenticated.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: Returned when the authenticated caller is not in the admin allowlist.

errors.name: BadRequest
errors.description: Returned when request parameters or cursor conditions are invalid.

errors.name: UnknownFeed
errors.description: Returned when the target feed URI is not registered.

errors.name: RevisionConflict
errors.description: Returned when a cursor does not match the current order revision.

errors.name: InternalServerError
errors.description: Returned when posts cannot be read.
